newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures shave losses, still down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures shave losses, still down.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures shaved the biggest losses, stayed moderately lower. Futures returned to range-trading after the quick break, partial recovery before T-bond futures closed. Brokers again cited long profittaking before Friday's April US jobs data and after big recent runup. They also repeated talk of asset allocation into bonds, out of stocks.
